messages.content:
**Latest news on Fervo Energy (Nasdaq: FRVO)**

**1. Cape Station reaches commercial operation — one day ahead of schedule (Sept 30, 2026)**
Fervo announced that its first power plant at Cape Station in Beaver County, Utah reached contractual commercial operation, making it the first greenfield enhanced geothermal (EGS) development in the world to do so. The first GeoBlock achieved **33 MW of net power production**, meeting the expected production threshold under its PPA, and is now generating revenue. Cape Station synchronized to the grid on September 24 and declared commercial operation six days later, one day before its contractual deadline — built and commissioned in just 23 months. CEO Tim Latimer: "No team has ever built a project like this anywhere in the world, and we did it ahead of schedule."
